main_biological_hypothesis: Within 2013 native or better-preserved sampled vegetation plots on four Azorean islands, taxa with documented Well-supported island-level extirpation somewhere in the archipelago may be disproportionately represented in higher-elevation native vegetation relative to the other indigenous taxa present in the same island plots.

rules.source_join: Darwin Core Event core <id index=0> matches Occurrence extension <coreid index=0>; NEVER occurrenceID/taxonID as event join key
rules.survey_year: all 232 Events expected in 2013; no posthoc addition or year imputation
rules.same_plot: source Event locationID; must yield 58 independently keyed plots with exactly 4 distinct sampled subplots each, otherwise STOP, do not use coordinate clustering to achieve 58
rules.surveyed_zero: species not listed in a valid completely surveyed 5×5 m subplot means sample-local not-detected; never whole-island biological absence
rules.species_unit: unique canonical Latin genus+species binomial of source species-rank (exclude subspecies and vague identifications); an occurrence positive must have a valid taxon and OTV quantity in 1..9, or report unknown
rules.establishment_native: accept only exact normalized native/NAT, endemic/END, indigenous, Azorean endemic strings; all other labels unknown or nonnative until author label confirmed in actual source vocabulary
rules.loss_affected_group: 20 uniquely canonical-binomial S1 Azores loss taxa; group assignment is independent of MOVECLIM source observations, no taxonomic synonyms/fuzzy match
rules.same_island_historic_loss: Only flag when canonical taxon and island both match S1 historic loss pair; not interpreted as 2013 recolonization
rules.plot_elevation: median minimumElevationInMeters of 4 subplots when exactly 4 same-plot entries; require max within-plot elevation spread <=30m else mark site uncertain and STOP primary if any
rules.relative_elevation: rank the 2013 plot median elevation in [0,1] within each island, midrank ties; plot not subplot is the primary sampling unit
rules.species_detection: collapse 2013 occurrence rows to plot×species positive, recording number of subplots and maximum OTV; species not detected at other sampled plots is a plot-local negative only
rules.reference_native: other source-identified native/endemic plant taxa with valid species rank and with >=1 sampled plot detection in that island, excluding the 20 S1 affected taxa
rules.comparison_metric: within each island, average elevation percentile of detected plots for each S1-affected native taxon versus each reference native taxon; report taxon counts, means and median, differences; no species as independent plots
rules.replication: four islands, 58 10×10m plots; do not treat 232 subplots as 232 independent locations
rules.main_statistical_endpoint: descriptive island-stratified elevation percentile difference; no causal p-value and no extinction risk odds ratio

limitations: 2013 plot forest transect explicitly selected relatively intact indigenous vegetation along elevation, so high-elevation 'refugium' contrast is within sampled habitat only.
2013 is not pre-extirpation for many S1 cases, and S1 record last observation is not extinction date.
The paper authors already studied plot community and invasion; avoid treating known native-altitude habitat patterns as new.
Sampling once in 2013 does not verify persistent plot occupancy or inter-island propagule movement.
Plot-level non-detection is not a true population absence and does not supply historic at-risk island universe.
Only 4 islands within a single archipelago; no new GEB confirmatory system admitted.
